name: HVAC for equipment/MCC rooms
description: HVAC for electrical equipment/MCC rooms maintains temperature, humidity and pressurisation, provides dilution ventilation and isolates on fire/gas detection. Sources read: IEEE Houston offshore electrical design seminar (USCG ambient and HVAC rules) and PDHonline M332 HVAC Design for Oil & Gas Facilities (ISO 15138/NORSOK H-001 basis). Primary source: https://r5.ieee.org/houston/wp-content/uploads/sites/32/2016/01/8-Offshore-Platform-Design-Apr-7-8.pdf

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — General design ambient temperature
specifications.basis: Ambient temperature of 40 oC (104 oF) except for the following

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Rotating electrical equipment in machinery rooms/weather decks
specifications.basis: 50 oC (122 oF) for rotating electrical equipment in “Machinery Rooms” and “Weather Decks” [unless 45 oC (113 oF) can be shown as a maximum for these spaces]

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Cables and non-rotating electrical equipment in machinery rooms/weather decks
specifications.basis: 45 oC (113 oF) for Cables and other non-rotating electrical equipment for “Machinery Rooms” and “Weather Decks”

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Air-conditioned space design temperature
specifications.basis: 30 oC (86 oF) is permitted in air conditioned spaces (but 40 oC is norm) – duplication of HVAC recommended

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Control and instrumentation equipment ambient
specifications.basis: 55 oC (131 oF) for all control and instrumentation equipment

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Electrical substation maximum temperature
specifications.basis: The temperatures are generally not required to exceed 40° C in the electrical substations

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Relative humidity target
specifications.basis: Offshore facilities are high in humidity, which needs to be controlled to comfortable levels of 50 ± 5%

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Hazardous/non-hazardous pressure differential
specifications.basis: Maintenance of a pressure differential between hazardous and non-hazardous areas (generally in the range of 30 to 70 Pa) is essential to prevent ingress of toxic or hazardous gases

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Process area mechanical ventilation rate
specifications.basis: The process areas should be provided with mechanical ventilation systems capable of continuously providing at least 12 air changes per hour

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Supply / return duct pressure drop
specifications.basis: The pressure drop in supply air ducting will be in the range of 1000 to 1500 Pa and that in return air ducting will be in the range of 500 to 1000 Pa

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Minimum outside air in manned areas
specifications.basis: In all manned areas, HVAC systems should provide a minimum of 20 CFM of outside air per person

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — Minimum separation of air intake and extract outlet
specifications.basis: The separation between air intakes and extract outlets should be a minimum of 4.5m, but greater where practicable

specifications.metric: HVAC system for electrical/MCC rooms (DX — HVAC motor rating
Battery room ventilation (UPS/battery ba — Hydrogen concentration limit
specifications.basis: Size the battery room ventilation system to prevent hydrogen concentration in the room from exceeding 2 percent by volume

specifications.metric: Battery room ventilation (UPS/battery ba — Battery room air changes (if battery data unavailable)
specifications.basis: In event the battery data is not available “maintain at least 12 air changes per hour”

specifications.metric: Battery room ventilation (UPS/battery ba — ABS large battery room ventilation
specifications.basis: ABS requires 1 air change every two minutes (30/hr) unless fewer are proven required through hydrogen emission calculations

specifications.metric: Battery room ventilation (UPS/battery ba — Threshold for large battery room classification
specifications.unit: kW of connected charging device output (lead acid)
specifications.basis: Large Battery Room > 2kW of connected charging device output (based on lead acid service)
